## CodeQL / Missing enum case in switch

Switch statement does not have a case for [UNKNOWN_STATE](1).

[Show more details](https://github.com/Corwin-Code/marketops-platform/security/code-scanning/68)

Correction evidence for CodeQL alert #68:

APPLY now has its own explicit UNKNOWN_STATE arm, separate from TIMEOUT. It preserves an unknown outcome and requires readback; it does not repeat a possibly executed write. PriceCommandWorkerIT and PriceWriteClassificationTest cover the transition.

Published in `6e44ed49de90e55b4558f1c0b76229d257729511`. Full backend runs 134 and 136 each pass 845 unit/architecture + 373 integration tests; all 11 required C1 CI contexts pass. CodeQL reports this alert fixed and the thread is already resolved. Evidence: `docs/07-phase-evidence/SLICE-V1-001/rework-r1/codeql-disposition.md` and `full-backend-134/`.

This records machine-review remediation only; no Frozen Finding or Controller acceptance is self-approved.

## CodeQL / Missing catch of NumberFormatException

Potential uncaught 'java.lang.NumberFormatException'.

[Show more details](https://github.com/Corwin-Code/marketops-platform/security/code-scanning/67)

Correction evidence for CodeQL alert #67:

Import rows are revalidated before application. Typed numeric JSON access and range/type checks reject NaN, fractional and overflowing quantities instead of reparsing unchecked text. FileIntakeFlowIT TC-INTAKE-011 covers the negative inputs and exact maximum integer.

Published in `6e44ed49de90e55b4558f1c0b76229d257729511`. Full backend runs 134 and 136 each pass 845 unit/architecture + 373 integration tests; all 11 required C1 CI contexts pass. CodeQL reports this alert fixed and the thread is already resolved. Evidence: `docs/07-phase-evidence/SLICE-V1-001/rework-r1/codeql-disposition.md` and `full-backend-134/`.

This records machine-review remediation only; no Frozen Finding or Controller acceptance is self-approved.

## CodeQL / Useless parameter

The parameter 'operator' is never used.

[Show more details](https://github.com/Corwin-Code/marketops-platform/security/code-scanning/71)

Correction evidence for CodeQL alert #71:

Profile registration now records CREATE audit attribution using operator, profile ID/version, organization, dataset and owner in the same transaction. FileIntakeFlowIT TC-INTAKE-010 verifies attribution and rollback if the audit record is refused.
